method.description: Reconstruct conformal factor and determinant-one conformal metric from ADM spatial metric; use contracted conformal Gamma^i = gamma_tilde^{jk} Gamma_tilde^i_jk in BSSN Ricci formula; independently compare reconstructed scalar Ricci with direct metric Ricci on periodic non-conformally-flat analytic controls and archived snapshots.
method.bug_found_and_fixed: The first reconstruction used Gamma^j_j_i (the connection trace) instead of the BSSN contracted conformal connection gamma_tilde^{jk} Gamma^i_jk. These are different contractions. The contracted connection and Christoffel index placement are now explicit in source.

matter_source_diagnostic.interpretation: Dense-region matter-source normalization is consistent with coefficient one; it does not explain the archived-H mismatch.

archived_native_H_comparison.domain: t=0 and t=128, tl=0, rl=2, trim4
archived_native_H_comparison.interpretation: The corrected independent geometry reconstruction does not make the saved native H agree; the discrepancy remains material.

archive_inventory.conclusion: The exact native discrete ML_BSSN H operator cannot be independently replayed from this archive: only ADM metric/extrinsic-curvature, matter, and H/M constraint snapshots are present. To close parity, an archived run must emit the conformal BSSN fields and pinned solver/source parameters at matching times.
